AUTOMATIC RELEASES (FOLLOWING SEM.VERSION vx.x.x) ARE CREATED WHEN A PR IS MERGED TO MAIN.

In order to create releases, please do the following:
- major (e.g. v2.3.1 => v3.0.0) => Please change the title to include #major
- minor (e.g. v2.3.1 => v2.4.0) => Please change the title to include #minor
- patch (e.g. v2.3.1 => v2.3.2) => DEFAULT merge will create this one
